columns.description: The number of columns in the screen (co). Default 80.

lines.description: The number of lines in the screen (li). Default 24.

tabstop.description: Tab width for the editor display (ts). Default 8.

shiftwidth.description: Autoindent and shift command indentation width (sw). Default 8.

shell.description: The shell used by the editor (sh). Default /bin/sh.

backup.description: Backup files before they are overwritten. If empty, backups are disabled.

directory.description: The directory where temporary files are created (dir).

recdir.description: The directory where recovery files are stored (recdir).

tags.description: List of tags files to search for tag lookups (tag). Items are flat strings.

ignorecase.description: Ignore case differences in regular expressions (ic).

number.description: Precede each line displayed with its current line number (nu).
